title: AMD expected to launch next generation of AI infrastructure to challenge Nvidia
title_zh: AMD预计推出下一代AI基础设施挑战Nvidia
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 23 (Reuters) - Advanced Micro Devices is set to launch a raft of AI hardware that ‌will rival Nvidia on Thursday at an event at a downtown convention ‌center in San Francisco.
summary_zh: 路透旧金山 7 月 23 日 - Advanced Micro Devices 将于周四在旧金山市中心会议中心举行的一次活动中推出一系列人工智能硬件，与 Nvidia 展开竞争。

title: Morning Bid: Magnificent cash burn
title_zh: 早间竞价：大量现金消耗
summary: July 23 (Reuters) - What matters in U. and global markets today , Editor-at-Large, Finance and Markets There was a familiar playbook in response to Alphabet's earnings beat and capital expenditure boost overnight - its stock fell and chip stocks rose.
summary_zh: 7 月 23 日（路透社） - 当今美国和全球市场最重要的是什么，《金融与市场》杂志特约编辑 对于隔夜 Alphabet 的盈利增长和资本支出增加，有一个熟悉的策略 - 其股价下跌，芯片股上涨。

title: Google Cloud is becoming Alphabet's new profit engine: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 谷歌云正在成为 Alphabet 新的利润引擎：每日图表
summary: Google Cloud delivered one of the rarest combinations in big tech — faster growth and wider profitability at the same time.
summary_zh: 谷歌云提供了大型科技领域最罕见的组合之一——同时实现更快的增长和更广泛的盈利能力。

title: Intel Needs More Than Blowout Earnings as Chips Rally Falters
title_zh: 随着芯片市场涨势疲软，英特尔需要的不仅仅是井喷式盈利
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Intel Corp. is expected to report strong second-quarter earnings after the market close Thursday, but even blowout results likely won’t be enough to reverse the stock’s July slide.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——英特尔公司预计将在周四收盘后公布强劲的第二季度收益，但即使是井喷的业绩也可能不足以扭转该股 7 月份的下滑趋势。

title: STMicro Plunges as Weak Forecast Eclipses Fourth-Quarter Outlook
title_zh: 由于疲软的预测掩盖了第四季度的前景，意法半导体股价暴跌
summary: (Bloomberg) -- STMicroelectronics NV plunged the most in a year after the chipmaker forecast third-quarter sales that missed analysts’ expectations, dimming hopes for a stronger recovery on the back of artificial intelligence data center demand.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——芯片制造商意法半导体公司第三季度销售额低于分析师预期，导致该公司股价出现一年来最大跌幅，这使得人工智能数据中心需求强劲复苏的希望黯淡。

title: Tesla-SpaceX merger? Musk cites 'more and more overlap'
title_zh: 特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并？马斯克称“重叠越来越多”
summary: Elon Musk addresses shareholder questions about a potential merger between Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX), noting their growing operational overlap before deferring to Tesla's General Counsel, who highlights their strategic partnership and joint work on initiatives like Terafa...
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 回答了股东有关特斯拉 (TSLA) 和 SpaceX (SPCX) 潜在合并的问题，指出两家公司的业务重叠日益增多，然后才听从特斯拉总法律顾问的意见，总法律顾问强调了他们的战略合作伙伴关系以及在 Terafa 等举措上的联合工作……

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq close lower ahead of technology earnings
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数在科技财报公布前收低

title: Amazon Investigated Over Chinese Influence by US Senate Panel
title_zh: 美国参议院小组调查亚马逊中国影响力

title: Inside Alphabet's earnings call with Google CEO Sundar Pichai
title_zh: Alphabet 与谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 举行的财报电话会议
summary: Yahoo Finance brings you inside Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) earnings call, led by Google CEO Sundar Pichai. Key takeaways include a 24% year-over-year increase in Alphabet's revenue, 17% growth in Search revenue, and a 13% rise in YouTube advertising revenue.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经为您带来由 Google 首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 主持的 Alphabet (GOOGL、GOOG) 财报电话会议。主要收获包括 Alphabet 收入同比增长 24%、搜索收入增长 17%、YouTube 广告收入增长 13%。
